label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark leads BMW Championship
items.text: Wyndham Clark overcame losing a five-shot lead with three final-hole birdies to win the BMW Championship at 17 under, holding off Rory McIlroy and Patrick Cantlay and securing FedEx Cup playoff momentum.

items.headline: La Sasso leads LIV Event
items.text: Rookie Michael La Sasso leads LIV Golf’s season-ending Indianapolis event, edging Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau as the tour canceled next week's Team Championship, casting doubt on its future.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Court Appearance Set
items.text: Tiger Woods is scheduled to appear in court on September 8 for charges stemming from a DUI arrest after a late-March high-speed rollover crash involving his Land Rover.
